title: Pure Differentially Private Pointwise CATE via Occupancy-Weighted Dense-Cell Pair Scores
banked_reason: The positioned unconditional converse is a real, usable lower-bound contribution, but the promised exact-uniform sparse-to-dense frontier has been replaced by an unconstructed score family and a conditional reduction, so no unconditional attaining estimator or upper frontier is delivered.
gap_reasons: The positioned unconditional converse is a real, usable lower-bound contribution, but the promised exact-uniform sparse-to-dense frontier has been replaced by an unconstructed score family and a conditional reduction, so no unconditional attaining estimator or upper frontier is delivered.
The framing explicitly discloses this limitation rather than falsely claiming a match, but the missing estimator and nuisance-dimension control keep the contribution below a field-level contribution.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved an unconditional exact-uniform pure-DP CATE converse, including the sparse two-fiber distance certificate and its transfer to a Kennedy-Theorem-1 superclass slice; the math referee passed it without findings. The matching upper frontier remained conditional because no explicit full-fiber sensitivity-one score family or nuisance-dimension-free weighted-shell certificate was constructed. A future retry should reuse the audited converse and focus exclusively on that missing achievability object rather than re-deriving the lower bound.
tldr: The occupancy-weighted score has an unconditional exact expectation and constant replacement sensitivity, while the exact-uniform Hölder class has unconditional \(\rho_G\) and \(\rho_F\) pure-private lower-bound terms in addition to its nonprivate minimax floor.  Inclusion in the common-support and common-constant slice of Kennedy et al.'s Theorem~1 lower-bound class transfers all of these converse terms upward.  The full-fiber occupancy lift remains the unresolved upper-construction crux on the exact-uniform class, so a matching upper frontier is only conditional; adaptation is downstream and wholly open, with no adaptive rate or logarithmic penalty claimed.
gap: No located result gives a pure-central-DP minimax frontier for pointwise CATE with unknown smooth propensity and outcome regression. The closest banked construction uses only exactly-two-record cells and therefore loses all signal when cell occupancy diverges.
fill: The project isolates the exact occupancy identity, derives a same-class lower frontier, and reduces full-class attainment to a nuisance-independent weighted-shell certificate for occupancy-weighted Hoeffding projections.
